# Knock Twice

*Osric keeps the old woodsmen's sayings. Put down 40 Driftstumps near the crews, then knock twice on the last stump on the Forest Shore.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Goa Harbour](../towns/goa_harbour_quests.md) |

| Given by | [Osric](../npcs/osric_woodsman.md) |

## Objectives

1. Defeat 40 [Driftstump](../monsters/driftstump.md)
2. Look at the last stump in [Gull Heath](../maps/gull_heath.md)

## Rewards

- 3,800 EXP
- 1,040 mesos
- [Salted Fish](../items/salted_fish.md) x10
- +20 standing with Goa Harbour
- +150 standing with [Osric](../npcs/osric_woodsman.md)
